# Context Chips

## Summary
A row of removable chips above the composer that shows exactly what the model will see with the next message — files, folders, documents from connected apps, web pages. Chips are added from one searchable menu, opened by a + button or by typing @, and each one can be removed in a click. Context the product adds on its own (the open file, the current page) gets its own chip that can be excluded but not deleted, so nothing is attached silently.

## When to use
- The model can draw on several kinds of source (local files, connected apps, the web) and the user should choose which ones a message uses.
- Answers depend heavily on the right material — code, specs, a thread — and guessing wrong is costly.
- The product adds context automatically and people need to see it and turn it off.
- Attachments should persist across follow-up messages until the user removes them.

## When not to use
- The model finds sources on its own well enough — searching the codebase or the web — and asking people to pick adds work for no gain. Offer chips as an override, not a required step.
- Only uploads are involved. Use an attachment tray with upload progress instead.
- Single-source products (one document, one dataset), where the source is implied and a chip would only repeat it.

## Anatomy
- Chip row: above the text input, one chip per source, in the order added. Each chip has a type icon, a truncated label (full path or URL on hover) and a remove button.
- Automatic chip: first in the row, styled as a toggle. Excluded, it turns dashed and struck through but stays in place so it can be brought back.
- Add context button: a + with a label in the composer's toolbar.
- Source menu: a search field, results grouped by kind (Files, Connectors, Web), each row with an icon, label, a second line (path, app and freshness, URL) and a check when attached. A footer hint names the keys.

## Behavior
- The + button and an @ typed at the start of the input or after a space open the same menu; the @ is consumed, not left in the text.
- The menu is multi-select: choosing a row adds or removes it and the menu stays open, so several sources can be picked in one go. Escape or an outside click closes it and returns focus to the input.
- Search filters across label, detail and group as the user types; an empty result says what didn't match.
- Removing a chip is immediate and undoable by adding it again — no confirm. Backspace in an empty input removes the last chip, as in tag inputs.
- Chips persist for follow-up messages in the same conversation until removed. Say so if the product drops them after sending.
- The automatic chip changes when its source changes (switching files updates it) and keeps its excluded state until the user includes it again.
- If a source can't be read (permissions, too large, still indexing), keep the chip and mark it, rather than removing it or failing the send silently.

## Content guidelines
- Labels are the source's own name ("pricing.ts", "#billing-launch"), not a type ("File", "Channel").
- The second line adds the thing people use to tell similar sources apart: a path, the app and when it was edited, a domain.
- Name the automatic chip after the thing, not the mechanism: "Checkout page", not "Current context".
- Hint text in the input teaches the shortcut once: "Ask anything… type @ to add context".

## Accessibility
- The chip row is a labelled list ("Context for this message"); each remove button is named "Remove <label>".
- The automatic chip is a toggle button with `aria-pressed` and a description of what it is, not only an eye icon.
- The menu's search field is a combobox controlling a multi-select listbox (`aria-multiselectable`), with `aria-activedescendant` following the arrow keys and `aria-selected` on attached rows.
- Additions and removals are announced in a polite live region ("Added pricing.ts").
- Chips animate in and out with a short scale; under `prefers-reduced-motion`, fade only and skip layout animation.

## Related patterns
- **Attachment Chip** — Use it instead when the user is uploading files and needs upload progress and retry.
- **Connector Panel** — Use it as well to connect the apps whose documents appear under Connectors in the menu.
- **Context Usage** — Use it as well to show how much of the context window the attached sources take up.
- **Instruction Tool Insert** — Use it instead when @ should insert a tool or instruction into the prompt, not attach a source.

## Default implementation (Tailwind v4 + Radix + Motion)

This is the catalogue's own reference implementation — use it verbatim when the
host project has no established design system, or when the user asks for
"the demoed look." When the host project has its own design system, treat
this code as a translation reference: keep every rule from the spec above
(Anatomy, Behavior, Content guidelines, Accessibility) and re-express the
markup, styling, and motion using that system's own components/tokens
instead of copying these Tailwind classes or the Motion API.

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import { ArrowUp, Check, Eye, EyeOff, Plus, Search, X, type LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface ContextSource {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  /** The menu section it is listed under, e.g. "Files", "Connectors", "Web". */
  group: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  /** A second line in the menu: a path, a URL, a count. */
  detail?: string;
}

export interface AutoContext {
  label: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  /** What it is, for the tooltip and screen readers: "The file you have open". */
  description: string;
  included: boolean;
  onIncludedChange: (included: boolean) => void;
}

export interface ContextChipsComposerProps {
  sources: ContextSource[];
  /** Ids of the sources attached to the next message. */
  value: string[];
  onChange: (ids: string[]) => void;
  /** Context the product adds on its own (the open file, the current page). Shown first, and can be excluded but not removed. */
  auto?: AutoContext;
  placeholder?: string;
  onSubmit?: (text: string, ids: string[]) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export function ContextChipsComposer({
  sources,
  value,
  onChange,
  auto,
  placeholder = "Ask anything… type @ to add context",
  onSubmit,
  className,
}: ContextChipsComposerProps) {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const [text, setText] = React.useState("");
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("");
  const [active, setActive] = React.useState(0);
  const [announcement, setAnnouncement] = React.useState("");
  const rootRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const textareaRef = React.useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const searchRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const triggerRef = React.useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const id = React.useId();

  const byId = React.useMemo(() => new Map(sources.map((s) => [s.id, s])), [sources]);
  const attached = value.map((v) => byId.get(v)).filter((s): s is ContextSource => Boolean(s));

  const filtered = React.useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return q
      ? sources.filter((s) => `${s.label} ${s.detail ?? ""} ${s.group}`.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      : sources;
  }, [sources, query]);
  const groups = React.useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, ContextSource[]>();
    for (const s of filtered) map.set(s.group, [...(map.get(s.group) ?? []), s]);
    return [...map.entries()];
  }, [filtered]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    function handle(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (rootRef.current && !rootRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
    }
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handle);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handle);
  }, [open]);

  function openMenu() {
    setQuery("");
    setActive(0);
    setOpen(true);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => searchRef.current?.focus());
  }

  function closeMenu() {
    setOpen(false);
    textareaRef.current?.focus();
  }

  function toggle(source: ContextSource) {
    if (value.includes(source.id)) {
      onChange(value.filter((v) => v !== source.id));
      setAnnouncement(`Removed ${source.label}`);
    } else {
      onChange([...value, source.id]);
      setAnnouncement(`Added ${source.label}`);
    }
  }

  function remove(source: ContextSource) {
    onChange(value.filter((v) => v !== source.id));
    setAnnouncement(`Removed ${source.label}`);
    textareaRef.current?.focus();
  }

  function submit() {
    if (!text.trim()) return;
    onSubmit?.(text.trim(), value);
    setText("");
  }

  function handleSearchKeyDown(e: React.KeyboardEvent) {
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActive((i) => Math.min(i + 1, filtered.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActive((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
    } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      const s = filtered[active];
      if (s) toggle(s);
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
      e.preventDefault();
      closeMenu();
    } else if (e.key === "Tab") {
      setOpen(false);
    }
  }

  const activeSource = filtered[active];

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={cn("relative w-full", className)}>
      <div className="rounded-2xl border bg-card p-2 shadow-sm">
        {(auto || attached.length > 0) && (
          <ul aria-label="Context for this message" className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 px-1 pt-1 pb-2">
            {auto && (
              <li>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-pressed={auto.included}
                  title={`${auto.description} — ${auto.included ? "click to exclude" : "click to include"}`}
                  onClick={() => auto.onIncludedChange(!auto.included)}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex h-7 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border px-2 text-xs transition-colors",
                    auto.included
                      ? "bg-muted text-foreground"
                      : "border-dashed text-muted-foreground line-through decoration-muted-foreground/60"
                  )}
                >
                  <auto.icon className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                  <span className="max-w-40 truncate">{auto.label}</span>
                  <span className="sr-only">, {auto.description}</span>
                  {auto.included ? (
                    <Eye className="size-3 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
                  ) : (
                    <EyeOff className="size-3" aria-hidden />
                  )}
                </button>
              </li>
            )}
            <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
              {attached.map((s) => (
                <motion.li
                  key={s.id}
                  layout={!reduce}
                  initial={reduce ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.9 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                  exit={reduce ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.9 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.14 }}
                  className="flex h-7 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-muted pr-0.5 pl-2 text-xs"
                >
                  <s.icon className="size-3.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
                  <span className="max-w-40 truncate" title={s.detail ?? s.label}>
                    {s.label}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={`Remove ${s.label}`}
                    onClick={() => remove(s)}
                    className="flex size-6 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-background hover:text-foreground"
                  >
                    <X className="size-3" aria-hidden />
                  </button>
                </motion.li>
              ))}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </ul>
        )}

        <textarea
          ref={textareaRef}
          rows={2}
          value={text}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          aria-label="Message"
          onChange={(e) => {
            const next = e.target.value;
            // "@" at the start or after a space opens the same menu as the + button.
            const typedAt = next.length === text.length + 1 && /(^|\s)@$/.test(next);
            if (typedAt) {
              setText(next.slice(0, -1));
              openMenu();
            } else {
              setText(next);
            }
          }}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Backspace" && text === "" && attached.length > 0) {
              e.preventDefault();
              remove(attached[attached.length - 1]);
            } else if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
              e.preventDefault();
              submit();
            }
          }}
          className="block w-full resize-none bg-transparent px-2 py-1 text-sm outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground"
        />

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
          <button
            ref={triggerRef}
            type="button"
            aria-haspopup="dialog"
            aria-expanded={open}
            aria-controls={open ? `${id}-menu` : undefined}
            onClick={() => (open ? closeMenu() : openMenu())}
            className="flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground aria-expanded:bg-accent aria-expanded:text-foreground"
          >
            <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden />
            Add context
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Send"
            onClick={submit}
            disabled={!text.trim()}
            className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-foreground text-background transition-opacity disabled:opacity-30"
          >
            <ArrowUp className="size-4" aria-hidden />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {open && (
          <motion.div
            id={`${id}-menu`}
            role="dialog"
            aria-label="Add context"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4, scale: 0.98 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 4, scale: 0.98 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.14, ease: "easeOut" }}
            className="absolute bottom-full left-0 z-20 mb-2 w-72 origin-bottom-left overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-lg"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b px-3">
              <Search className="size-3.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
              <input
                ref={searchRef}
                value={query}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setQuery(e.target.value);
                  setActive(0);
                }}
                onKeyDown={handleSearchKeyDown}
                placeholder="Search files, apps and the web"
                role="combobox"
                aria-expanded
                aria-controls={`${id}-list`}
                aria-activedescendant={activeSource ? `${id}-opt-${activeSource.id}` : undefined}
                aria-label="Search context sources"
                className="h-9 w-full bg-transparent text-sm outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground"
              />
            </div>
            <ul
              id={`${id}-list`}
              role="listbox"
              aria-multiselectable
              aria-label="Context sources"
              className="max-h-56 overflow-auto p-1"
            >
              {groups.length === 0 && (
                <li className="px-2.5 py-6 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">Nothing matches “{query}”</li>
              )}
              {groups.map(([group, items]) => (
                <li key={group} role="presentation">
                  <p className="px-2.5 pt-2 pb-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">{group}</p>
                  <ul role="group" aria-label={group}>
                    {items.map((s) => {
                      const index = filtered.indexOf(s);
                      const selected = value.includes(s.id);
                      return (
                        <li
                          key={s.id}
                          id={`${id}-opt-${s.id}`}
                          role="option"
                          aria-selected={selected}
                          onMouseEnter={() => setActive(index)}
                          onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                          onClick={() => toggle(s)}
                          className={cn(
                            "flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5",
                            index === active && "bg-accent"
                          )}
                        >
                          <s.icon className="size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
                          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <span className="block truncate text-sm">{s.label}</span>
                            {s.detail && (
                              <span className="block truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.detail}</span>
                            )}
                          </span>
                          <Check className={cn("size-4 shrink-0", !selected && "invisible")} aria-hidden />
                        </li>
                      );
                    })}
                  </ul>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
            <p className="border-t px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              Enter to add or remove · Esc to close
            </p>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <span className="sr-only" aria-live="polite">
        {announcement}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
```
